cloudflare_error.title: Error 1102: Worker exceeded resource limits
cloudflare_error.detail: A Worker script configured by the website owner exceeded its resource limits (CPU time or memory) and was terminated.
cloudflare_error.what_you_should_do: Do not retry. The same request will hit the same resource limits. The site owner must optimize the Worker script.

observations: The first ten requests returned HTTP 200 before the first resource-limit response.
From item 11 onward, every remaining request returned Cloudflare Error 1102 in this direct 60-symbol diagnostic.
The response was Cloudflare platform JSON, not the OHLC endpoint CANONICAL_READER_FAILED JSON path.
This file is post-fix diagnostic evidence only. It does not modify or reinterpret the immutable 2026-08-31 original research receipt or selection evidence.
